description: Implement caching for get_type_hints calls to significantly improve import performance, particularly for classes with heavy initialization logic. This optimization should reduce app import times by caching expensive type hint calculations that occur during subclass initialization.
functional_requirements: Cache get_type_hints results to avoid redundant calculations during class initialization
Ensure the caching mechanism works correctly with inheritance hierarchies and subclass relationships
Maintain type hint accuracy while eliminating repeated expensive computations
Implement cache invalidation or appropriate cache scope to prevent stale type information
Focus optimization on state-related classes where initialization overhead is most significant
Verify performance improvements without breaking existing type checking functionality
